title: DAG Structure Learning with Node-Varying Heavy-Tailed Disturbances
abstract: arXiv:2610.13304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: DAG structures can be learned from observations by incorporating acyclicity via smooth constraints, such as DAGMA's log-determinant function. Typically, observations and the underlying DAG are related through linear structural equation models, with Gaussianity assumption on the disturbances at each node. Extending DAG learning methods that account for scale and tail behavior of disturbances that vary across nodes remains a challenge. We propose a node-varying Student-$t$ DAGMA that jointly estimates the graph structure, node-specific disturbance scales, and the degrees-of-freedom parameter. A Gaussian scale-mixture representation yields an iteratively reweighted formulation that down-weights large standardized residuals. Building on existing results, we also establish identifiability of the graph and disturbance parameters. translated_title: 具有节点异质重尾扰动的DAG结构学习
translated_abstract: DAG（有向无环图）结构可以通过引入保证无环性的平滑约束（如DAGMA的对数行列式函数）从观测数据中学习得到。通常情况下，观测数据与潜在的DAG通过线性结构方程模型相关联，并对每个节点的扰动假设服从高斯分布。如何扩展DAG学习方法以考虑跨节点变化的扰动尺度与尾部行为，仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了节点异质的Student-t DAGMA方法，能够联合估计图结构、节点特定的扰动尺度以及自由度参数。借助高斯尺度混合表示，我们得到了一个迭代重加权的求解形式，可对较大的标准化残差进行降权处理。基于已有结果，我们还建立了图结构与扰动参数的可识别性。合成实验表明，在异质重尾扰动条件下，该方法在结构恢复方面表现更为优异。
tldr: 提出了节点异质的Student-t DAGMA方法，可联合估计DAG图结构与跨节点变化的重尾扰动参数，在异质重尾噪声下显著提升了图结构恢复的准确性。
en_tdlr: We propose a node-varying Student-t DAGMA method that jointly estimates the DAG structure, node-specific disturbance scales, and degrees-of-freedom parameters, achieving improved structural recovery under heterogeneous heavy-tailed disturbances.
